result.title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
result.summary: Large language models reinvent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 agentic reasoning caching：把 LLM 的推理轨迹转成可在 CPU 上执行的智能体推理缓存（ARC），在新问题实例上复用已推得的解法，在数学与科学任务上取得与前沿模型相当的表现且调用成本低 16–291 倍。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「推理轨迹编译为可复用、可解释执行体」的思路，可供核查 LVR 中的轨迹监督、推理状态复用与推理成本/停止决策评价之间的对应关系；但该工作为纯文本且无视觉证据通路，迁移需自行判断。
